# FLX-3613: a consumers block holds more than the engine reads

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A block carries at most 64 prefixes, 1,024 queries, 256 views, 256 parameters in a query and 64 calibration parameters. Split the questions across Simulations.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3613
```
